about: Framing review: where each Wikipedia summary departs from Wikipedia's own neutrality and wording guidelines, plus a separately labelled reviewer's note on point of view and omissions. Shown next to the summary, never merged into it. Not a fact-check and not a verdict on the events.
reviewer: Claude (claude-opus-5-5), an AI model made by Anthropic. Not checked line by line by a person.
